verdict.rationale: Pylon documents user-configurable scheduling only for AI Reports, which deliver automated data summaries to Slack on a schedule. Triggers and Background Agents provide workflows and automations, but the evidence shows them reacting to events and incoming issues rather than running on a recurring schedule. The daily Salesforce summary sync is a built-in job, not one the user schedules. Missing for 10: schedule-based (cron/recurring) triggers for general workflows, scheduled agent runs, an API for managing schedules, and hands-on corroboration.
